anomalies.observed: C3, the only capacitor on the LM1117-5.0 output rail (+5V, which is U3 pin 2 / VO), is 100nF in an 0805 footprint. There is no bulk capacitor anywhere on the +5V rail (C2 is the only other capacitor and sits on the VCC input rail).
anomalies.expected: The LM1117-5.0 requires a minimum output capacitance on the order of 10µF (with ESR inside the datasheet's stable range) for loop stability. A 100nF output capacitor is roughly two orders of magnitude below that requirement.
anomalies.impact: The 5V LDO may oscillate / be unstable, so the +5V rail feeding the MCUs (U1.8, U2.8), the potentiometer (J9.1) and the reset pull-up (R8.1) could be noisy or out of regulation, causing erratic operation or resets.

parsed.summary: Connectivity, component types, polarities and footprints all check out against standard practice, but the LM1117-5.0's output capacitor (C3) is only 100nF instead of the ~10µF the regulator needs for stability, so the +5V rail may be unstable.
